meta.notes: How the world starts: a World Type called Blossom Isles of islands floating over the void, all cherry grove, listed on the Create New World screen, and the start island msm_examples:blossom_isles/island high above the others at 0 160 0, placed when the first player joins, with the spawn on it and ten seconds of slow falling for each new player. Everything lowers to plain data pack files.
